#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cstring>
using namespace std;

const int MOD = 1000000007;
vector<vector<int>> memo;

int value(int row, int col) {
    if (memo[row][col] != -1) {
        return memo[row][col];
    }

    int result;
    if (col == 0) {
        result = 1;
    } else {
        int left = value(row, col - 1);
        int up = (row > col) ? value(row - 1, col) : 0;
        result = (left + up) % MOD;
    }

    memo[row][col] = result;
    return result;
}

int main() {
    int n;
    cin >> n;

    memo.assign(n + 1, vector<int>(n + 1, -1));

    long long sum = 0;
    for (int row = 0; row <= n; row++) {
        if ((row & 1) == 1) {
            sum = (sum + value(row, 0)) % MOD;
        }
    }

    for (int row = 1; row <= n; row++) {
        for (int col = 1; col <= row; col++) {
            if (((row + col) & 1) == 1) {
                sum = (sum + value(row, col)) % MOD;
            }
        }
    }

    cout << sum << endl;
    return 0;
}
